create.title: Finite endpoint-free beta vector and fixed-box Plemelj realization
create.statement_tex: On one common fixed-w finite antecedent define V_ef_fin=V_pre_fin-M_fin, where M_fin is the globally routed endpoint plus recombined R1 arithmetic module. Under common artificial-pole ownership, V_ef_fin=T[R1]+S[R1]+P_rho[R1]. Compact beta support deletes the complete transferred S[R1] vector for S>(U+V)/2+2B0. The remaining terminal/artificial package has exactly sixteen product Cauchy--Green cells: four boundary products, four boundary-axis terms, one corner, four connector-boundary terms, two connector-axis terms, and one mixed psi''/4 area, with one combined collision coefficient. At every fixed U,V,S its hard-top limit is the signed normalized distribution (1/2)delta_0-(i/(2pi))PV(1/mu), and the induced moving-face logarithms are locally integrable. No outside-height/profile limit or symbol estimate is asserted.
create.next_action: Use this only at fixed boxes and then prove the separate complete positive-line Cauchy tail; do not infer a global physical limit or terminal symbol bound.

create.title: Complete actual-profile Cauchy tail for the endpoint-free beta vector
create.statement_tex: Let F_ef(b;U,S;nu) be the complete positive-b, fixed-w, endpoint-free density obtained after the fixed-box signed top Plemelj limit and finite Stokes recombination, with every actual profile, floor, character, collision convention, and external normalization retained. Prove that the signed tail integral over V1<|nu|<=V2 tends to zero uniformly along the prescribed symmetric U,V,S and physical-profile exhaustion, equivalently J_ef(2H,2H)-J_ef(H,H) tends to zero for the exact polytope-aware Plemelj functional. A sufficient stronger statement is an integrable uniform nu-majorant for the top value, its mu-difference quotient, and the regular u integral. No lambda-symbol or target-size estimate is included.
create.next_action: In beta-slab coordinates t=(mu+nu)/2+beta, derive the exact joint large-height asymptotic of the complete omega-recombined positive-line density and prove its signed Cauchy tail or a uniform difference-quotient majorant.

update.statement_tex: The fixed-w finite complement V_ef_fin=V_pre_fin-M_fin, its complete sixteen-cell inventory, radial-side deletion, and fixed-box signed Plemelj realization are proved. Its unique symmetric outside-height and physical-profile limit is equivalent to the complete actual positive-b Cauchy-tail criterion for F_ef(b;U,S;nu), with all moving faces, axes, connectors, collision germs, profiles, floors, character factors, and external normalization retained. Prove that tail criterion before defining the limiting endpoint-free connector-completed beta axial vector. No target-size or terminal-symbol estimate is included.
update.next_action: Prove the complete signed positive-b Cauchy-tail lemma uniformly along the actual profile exhaustion; finite Plemelj and local moving-log control alone are insufficient.
The finite post-module ledger is closed. Await the complete actual-profile Cauchy tail before defining its limiting physical axial vector.
Treat finite compatibility as proved; global compatibility still waits on the endpoint-free actual-profile Cauchy tail.
Wait for the complete endpoint-free Cauchy tail and limiting axial vector before defining the local axial-subtracted terminal symbol.

reject.reason: A bounded smooth counterfunctional has a valid signed Plemelj limit on every finite box but distinct subsequential symmetric outside-height limits; the actual kernel therefore needs an additional uniform tail theorem.
Compact beta support kills separated radial w-sides only. On an outside u or v face, t can track (mu+nu)/2 so beta remains in the mask support.

Horizontal connectors integrate real-abscissa displacement at finite imaginary height and, together with axes and connectors, reassemble the original positive-b vertical; they are not the omitted |nu| tail.
Local logarithmic integrability controls each fixed polytope but gives no decay as its faces and saddles escape to infinity.

The mask Fourier transform decays in its auxiliary variable, not in both unbounded directions tangent to the beta slab; the coupled gamma/radial factors and hard-top PV difference quotient still lack a uniform integrable majorant.
Absolute convergence of the coefficient series on fixed real lines justifies finite-box algebra but does not dominate the joint s,u,v height exhaustion or the physical top distribution.

The common endpoint/R1 arithmetic module is subtracted once by global finite routing. Removing endpoint prefixes, Perron tails, or arithmetic shares again from individual beta cells double counts the boundary module.

no_change.reason: The endpoint-free Cauchy tail, limiting axial vector, terminal symbol bound, beta transition, and residual M1 corridor remain open.
Round 37 concerns only the M1 beta axial architecture.
No unconditional Gauss-circle estimate is claimed.

round_assessment.reason: Round 37 proves the exact finite endpoint-free vector and fixed-box distribution, reduces all optional cells to one complete actual positive-line Cauchy tail, and supplies a sharp generic counterfunctional showing why a new actual-kernel tail theorem is indispensable.
